justification: Changes three public pages' headline statistics and two guides' promises about citations, changes what the bulk PDF uploader writes to dcp_chapter_registry, and changes what the outreach gate accepts for claims 8 and 13. A wrong change either republishes an unsourced number or lets citation links drift onto the wrong document again.

pre_impl.existing_data: frontend-nextjs/lib/coverage.ts COVERAGE and COVERAGE_DISPLAY (riskLayers 8, flagged UNVERIFIED on 2026-09-11); the stat strips on the homepage, /for/homebuyers and /for/buyers-agents; dcp_chapter_registry.r2_current_path and r2_public_pdf_url, which the citation links read; scripts/r2_monitor.py R2_PUBLIC_BASE.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The uploader assumed moving r2_current_path was enough, but citation links read r2_public_pdf_url: 15 active chapters' links named an older copy, and Waverley DCP 2022's opened a 490-page PDF while its rules cite the 448-page current one (28 of 30 sampled rules on the cited page in the current copy, 1 of 30 in the linked copy). The coverage tests assumed COVERAGE was the only export, so removing the number left COVERAGE_DISPLAY.riskLayers = '8' behind unnoticed.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Extends the existing upsert_registry statement with one derived column, using the same public base r2_monitor.py already writes. Removes one existing key and three existing tiles. Adds one sql_count sub-check to claim 8 and replaces claim 13's placeholder with the existing no_rendered_phrase building block.
pre_impl.external_source_error: The R2 public base is a constant shared with r2_monitor.py and pinned equal by a test. If a hosted copy were not publicly downloadable the link would 404; all 15 repaired links were requested and returned HTTP 200 before the database change was committed.
pre_impl.frontend_type: COVERAGE_DISPLAY loses the riskLayers key; no remaining code references it (searched app, components, lib and __tests__), so the CoverageKey type narrows without breaking a caller. Three stat grids change from four columns to three to match the tiles left.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A homebuyer or buyers' agent read '8 risk layers' as a measured capability with no list behind it. A planner following a Waverley citation landed ten to twenty pages from the rule. The guides promised exact, accurate pages that several chapters do not deliver.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_coverage_source_derived_stats.py tests/test_r2_upload_registry_link.py tests/test_dq_check_outreach.py -o addopts="" -q; python scripts/outreach_claim_checks.py OC-13; python scripts/outreach_claim_checks.py OC-8
falsifiable_check.external_authority: The uploader test pins the public base against r2_monitor.py's own constant, a different module; the retired-figure checks read the rendered page sources, not the test's own list; the link sub-check reads production dcp_chapter_registry, where the mismatch was measured independently beforehand (15 before the repair, 0 after, by both an exact suffix comparison and LIKE).
falsifiable_check.fails_when: A re-upload moves r2_current_path without the link; the link and current path name different version folders; riskLayers is exported again from COVERAGE or COVERAGE_DISPLAY; a Risk layers tile returns to any of the three pages; or any active chapter's public link stops ending with its current path.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Forced, each restored afterwards. Removing r2_public_pdf_url from the uploader's UPDATE SET: FAILED test_the_link_is_written_from_the_current_copy_on_insert_and_on_update, 1 failed 4 passed. Putting a Risk layers tile back on /for/homebuyers: FAILED test_the_retired_risk_layers_figure_stays_retired. Re-exporting COVERAGE_DISPLAY.riskLayers: FAILED test_the_retired_risk_layers_figure_stays_retired, 1 failed 6 passed. Before that test was strengthened, the outreach gate itself caught the leftover export: OC-13 FAIL, 1 rendered occurrence ['frontend-nextjs/lib/coverage.ts:164'].
falsifiable_check.measured: 25 passed across the three test files. OC-13 HOLDS (4 passed; 0 rendered occurrences). OC-8 FAILS for its existing reasons (72 of 835 served numbers missing a clause, sentence or PDF link; DQ-39), and its new link sub-check PASSES at 0. Full gate on this branch: 10 of 17 claims pass, 0 contradicted, exit 3.

functions.name: upsert_registry
functions.input: A cursor, one registry row dict with council, chapter_key, r2_current_path, r2_version_label and the source metadata, and the dry_run flag.
functions.output: One INSERT ... ON CONFLICT statement whose parameters add r2_public_pdf_url built from R2_PUBLIC_BASE and r2_current_path, set on insert and on update.
functions.if_none: r2_current_path None gives r2_public_pdf_url None, so a chapter with no hosted copy is never given a link; a dry run executes nothing.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/r2_upload_pdfs.py: A real run uploads PDFs to production R2 and upserts production registry rows, so it cannot run as a test. The statement's effect was measured on production instead: the same link rule applied to the 15 mismatched chapters in a backed-up, dry-run-first transaction, with every new link requested and returning HTTP 200 before commit. tests/test_r2_upload_registry_link.py executes the real function source and pins the SQL and parameters.

values.value: R2_PUBLIC_BASE, the public host of the hosted PDF copies.
values.read_at: Module import of scripts/r2_upload_pdfs.py, used in upsert_registry.
values.if_missing: Not optional -- a literal; test_the_base_matches_the_one_the_change_monitor_uses fails if it drifts from scripts/r2_monitor.py.

queries.purpose: Chapter public link compared with the current hosted copy (claim 8)
queries.where_clause: is_active AND r2_current_path IS NOT NULL AND r2_public_pdf_url IS NOT NULL AND right(r2_public_pdf_url, length(r2_current_path) + 1) <> ('/' || r2_current_path)

queries.purpose: Registry upsert written by the bulk uploader
queries.where_clause: INSERT with ON CONFLICT (council, chapter_key) DO UPDATE; no WHERE, one row per call, keyed by the unique council and chapter pair.

break_it.scenario: A council PDF is re-uploaded by the bulk uploader into a new version folder, the way 15 chapters' current copies moved.
break_it.what_happens: The registry upsert moved r2_current_path and left the public link on the old copy, so citations opened a different document from the one the rules were read from.
break_it.how: The link is derived from r2_current_path in the same statement and updated on conflict; removing it from the UPDATE fails test_the_link_is_written_from_the_current_copy_on_insert_and_on_update.

break_it.scenario: The claim 8 link check is written with LIKE '%' || r2_current_path, and a path contains an underscore.
break_it.what_happens: An underscore is a LIKE wildcard, so a public link to a different copy whose path differs only at that character would count as matching and the chapter link check would pass wrongly.
break_it.how: The check compares the exact suffix with right(r2_public_pdf_url, length(r2_current_path) + 1) against '/' || r2_current_path; measured 0 on production, the same as the LIKE form today.
break_it.repro: SELECT count(*) FROM dcp_chapter_registry WHERE is_active AND r2_current_path IS NOT NULL AND r2_public_pdf_url IS NOT NULL AND right(r2_public_pdf_url, length(r2_current_path) + 1) <> ('/' || r2_current_path)

break_it.scenario: The number is removed from COVERAGE but COVERAGE_DISPLAY still exports riskLayers = '8'.
break_it.what_happens: Any page could render the unsourced figure again from the display map while every test reading COVERAGE passed; this is exactly what the first cut of this change left behind.
break_it.how: The retired-figure test now scans every non-comment line of coverage.ts, and claim 13's rendered-phrase check scans app, components and lib; re-adding the display key fails the test.

break_it.scenario: Someone restores the tile as a literal, { value: '8', label: 'Risk layers' }, without touching coverage.ts.
break_it.what_happens: The coverage key check alone would pass while the page shows the retired figure.
break_it.how: The test reads the homepage and both audience pages for 'Risk layers', and claim 13 checks rendered sources for the label; the forced tile on /for/homebuyers failed the test.

break_it.scenario: One tile is removed from a four-column stat grid.
break_it.what_happens: The strip would render three tiles and an empty fourth column on wide screens, which reads as missing content.
break_it.how: The three grids change from sm:grid-cols-4 to sm:grid-cols-3 in the same edit as the tile removal.
break_it.repro: Open /, /for/homebuyers and /for/buyers-agents at a width of 640px or more and check the stat strip shows three evenly spaced tiles.

break_it.scenario: A per-council registry script (populate_waverley_registry.py and its siblings) is re-run and moves r2_current_path without the link.
break_it.what_happens: Links could drift onto an older copy again, the way the 15 did, with nothing at write time preventing it.
break_it.how: Not changed here: those scripts are one-off council loaders. The claim 8 sub-check fails as soon as any active chapter's link names a different copy, so the drift is caught at the next gate run rather than prevented.
break_it.repro: python scripts/outreach_claim_checks.py OC-8 -- the 'public PDF link is not their current copy' line.

post_merge.db_reset: No -- the 15 links were repaired in production on 2026-09-14 at 18:19 (backup data/db_rollback_backups/dcp_chapter_registry_pre_public_link_current_2026-09-14_1819.csv); this change only stops the uploader recreating the mismatch.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes -- after the Vercel deploy, the homepage, /for/homebuyers and /for/buyers-agents show three stat tiles with no 'Risk layers'; /user-guide and /quick-guide no longer promise exact or accurate pages; python scripts/dq_check.py --outreach reports 10 of 17 with OC-13 passing.
